title: Spec: gateway reputation tracking in RPL parent selection
description: Nodes track per-gateway delivery success rate: send probe packets through each gateway, measure response rate. Gateways with sustained low delivery (<50% over 5 minutes) are deprioritized in RPL parent selection. Not a blacklist — just a preference signal. Add to spec/05-routing.md. Complements multi-gateway route validation (sibling bead).
